title: airgap: deterministic delta bundles for ppc64le (POWER9) and signed snapshot indices
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private in on-prem IBM POWER clusters reported long airgap bundle creation times and occasional checksum mismatches when reconstructing images on ppc64le nodes. This PR adds platform-specific deterministic delta bundle generation for ppc64le (POWER9) and upgrades the airgap index format to v2: a signed, timestamped snapshot manifest that enables atomic rollbacks and reproducible upgrades across architectures.

What this PR does: Adds a new delta packing pipeline for ppc64le that enforces deterministic ordering of tar entries, normalizes mtime/uid/gid, and uses content-addressed chunking to produce small atomic delta bundles. Introduces an indexed snapshot manifest (airgap-index-v2.json) which is signed with the existing bundle signing key; installers and the offline registry-sync tool verify signatures before applying snapshots. Updates the terraform registry-sync module to support ppc64le mirroring and to publish signed snapshot manifests to the offline registry metadata bucket.

Migration and compatibility: The new v2 index is backward-compatible for consumers that only read full bundles (the index is optional). Older installers will continue to work with full bundles but will ignore v2 snapshot manifests. Customers who opt-in to delta upgrades must upgrade their installer to the release that contains the verification logic (this PR) to safely consume v2 snapshots. A small migration script (tools/migrate-index-to-v2.sh) is included to convert existing index blobs to the new format and sign them.

Testing and validation: Unit tests for deterministic tar ordering and signature verification were added. End-to-end validation was run in a ppc64le lab with real-world workloads: full airgap creation -> delta generation -> staged upgrade -> rollback to previous snapshot. The e2e tests include validation that the same delta produced on two different hosts is byte-identical when given the same input images (reproducibility). CI includes a cross-arch matrix that runs lightweight smoke checks on x86_64 and ppc64le emulation.

Rollback story: Snapshot manifests include an atomic previous pointer; the registry-sync module publishes both the current and previous manifests. The installer will attempt delta apply and, on corruption or signature mismatch, fallback to the full bundle and record an incident in the installer logs. A helper command (installer rollback --to-snapshot <id>) is implemented to simplify operator-driven refunds to the prior known-good snapshot.

Security: Signed manifests and stricter signature verification reduce the attack surface for airgap metadata tampering. The signing flow reuses the existing offline signing key and adds a verification step in registry-sync to fail fast if a manifest is unsigned or malformed.

Notes: This change was coordinated with the terraform and registry teams to ensure mirror paths for ppc64le are versioned and retained for at least two snapshots per retention policy. Documentation updates are included under docs/airgap/v2-index.md.

review_comments: Liam Ortega: Can we guarantee identical chunk boundaries across different tar implementations? If not, we should add a canonicalizer step. (requested changes)
Maya Chen: Added a canonicalizer that re-chunks using content-addressed 64MiB windows; updated tests to assert byte-identical output across machines. Replying to @Liam Ortega.
Ravi Kapoor: Please add an integration smoke test that simulates an interrupted delta apply and verifies rollback. (requested changes)
Maya Chen: Added e2e step to simulate corrupted delta and verified installer falls back to full bundle and logs the incident. Replying to @Ravi Kapoor.
Nina Park: Security review — signature verification looks good but ensure the public key rotation story is documented. (approved)
Maya Chen: Added key rotation notes to docs and a small helper to rotate keys in the offline metadata bucket. Replying to @Nina Park.
release_notes: Add deterministic delta bundle generation for ppc64le and a signed v2 airgap snapshot manifest. Includes rollback helpers and terraform registry-sync support. Backwards compatible: older installers still accept full bundles. Operators must upgrade to consume v2 snapshots.
